INFORMATION

Use & download
information.

A few clear expectations before you download.

Content permissions

Only download content you own or are authorized to save, where permitted by the relevant platform. Access to a video does not itself grant copying or redistribution rights. NexaTik does not grant rights to third-party content or bypass private account permissions.

Current availability

The current NexaTik 0.5.2 release is free. A paid activation system or ten-video trial limit has not been added. NexaRemote and NexaConnect are product previews on this website; public downloads are not yet listed.

Platform access and release limits

Content platforms can change their interfaces, access rules and verification flows. Available videos, metadata and profile lists can vary. New browser routes are not a promise that every account or video will work.

Installers and updates

Use the complete installer from the linked NexaTik GitHub release. Finish active work before installing or updating. Keep your own copies of important videos and metadata. The application requires internet access for content requests and update checks.

Independent software

Nexa Software is not presented as affiliated with YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, AnyDesk or TeamViewer. Their names identify platforms or other products and remain associated with their respective owners.
